text:
### Information Sharing  
**FCA/Regulatory Notification:**
- Large fraud losses reported to FCA
- Fraud patterns shared with industry
- Suspicious activity referral to NCA (if ML suspected)

raw_entities.description: Policy governing the bank's obligations to report fraud losses to the FCA, share fraud patterns with industry participants, and refer suspicious activity to the NCA when money laundering is suspected.
